اندعست (form VII)

# اِنْدَعَسْتَ (indaʕasta) /in.da.ʕas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
# اِنْدَعَسْتِ (indaʕasti) /in.da.ʕas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْدَعَسَ (indaʕasa)
# اِنْدَعَسَتْ (indaʕasat) /in.da.ʕa.sat/: third-person
